title: Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams Not Accessible

blocks.text: In Zscaler Client Connector versions 4.1.0.82 for Windows, Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams applications are not accessible when using Tunnel with Local Proxy while connected to the Internet & SaaS service because the option to Disable Loopback Restriction fails in some scenarios.
This issue was fixed in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.98 for Windows.
